Licence, Security & Trustworthiness

UEA8 operates under a Gaming Curacao sub-licence (#365/JAZ), which is a standard regulatory framework for offshore casinos. However, this licence is currently in a transitional period. The Curacao Gaming Control Board (GCB) revoked the master licence (#365/JAZ) in August 2024 as part of a broad restructuring.

It is now mandatory for all sub-licensees to reapply for direct approval using the new process. The regulatory status of UEA8 remains uncertain until it renews its GCB accreditation; therefore, players should verify any current license paperwork before making a deposit.

The fact that UEA8 isn’t on PAGCOR’s official whitelist further indicates that it lacks legal recognition in Malaysia and the Philippines. There is some wiggle room for internet casinos like UEA8 under Malaysian law, as they are not directly regulated by statutes such as the Betting Act 1953 or the Common Gaming Houses Act. Although this does not make the site inherently unlawful, it does remove any governmental safeguards for consumers.

UEA8 works well in terms of security. It protects data with 256-bit SSL encryption and maintains server stability with Cloudflare DDoS protection. On the other hand, two-factor authentication (2FA), which is becoming the norm for premium platforms, is not available on this platform. One helpful feature is an internal fraud detection system that may identify questionable transactions and possible misuse of promotions.

Although there are some gaps, UEA8 has been around for over 10 years, which lends it some legitimacy in a field where many platforms come and go. However, due to its lack of transparency and one significant withdrawal complaint from 2023, external watchdogs have rated its dependability at 2.7 out of 10.

To sum up, UEA8 has solid technological protections and a long-standing reputation; however, players should exercise caution, particularly when playing with significant sums, due to the absence of two-factor authentication (2FA), license uncertainty, and exclusion from PAGCOR whitelists.
